A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CaPO research and provide readable main text, Appendices A–C, equations, seven tables, and ten figures. Text extraction and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original diffusion-model fine-tuning experiments, benchmark evaluations, ablations, and a human preference study in Appendix C and Table 7.

after.justification: V2 retains the original fine-tuning experiments, benchmark results, ablations, and appendix human preference study.

M1.justification: Reward calibration, the CaPO regression objective, Pareto-frontier pair selection, and loss weighting remain unchanged. Notation and bracket corrections in Equations (2), (7), and (8) do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain DiffusionDB training prompts, the Pick-a-pic comparison, Parti and DPG-bench evaluation, GenEval and T2I-Compbench benchmarks, and GenAI-bench prompts for the appendix user study. No dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain DPO, IPO, SUM, SOUP, Diffusion-DPO, DPO-Syn, and the same base and larger diffusion models. The five newly cited related works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same prompt counts, images per prompt, samplers, guidance scales, training budgets, model configurations, and evaluation metrics. Appendix C also retains the 200-prompt user-study comparisons with five raters per pair.

E4.justification: The sample-count exploration, loss-weighting ablations in Tables 5–6, single-versus-multi-reward analysis in Figure 7, and qualitative cases are retained. No new robustness test, ablation, or supplementary analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-score and win-rate reporting without adding confidence intervals, significance tests, or training-seed and repeated-run information. The appendix user-study reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All seven tables retain their result entries and numerical values, and the qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains CaPO GenEval overall scores of 0.59 for SDXL and 0.71 for SD3-M; Table 7 retains win rates of 54.5%, 52.0%, and 53.5%.

T1.justification: Following Equation (4), v2 corrects the DPO loss example from g(u) = −log u to g(u) = −log σ(u). This repairs the mathematical expression and makes it consistent with Equation (22), already present in both appendices. The appendix derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction narrows the stated unresolved problem from reward-based fine-tuning without human preference data generally to alignment using multiple reward models. The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion otherwise retain the same methodological and performance claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning reward hacking, reward correlations, and multi-reward benefits are retained. Section 5.4 preserves the limitations from base-model capability and offline-data convergence, while Appendix B retains the qualification about comparisons against larger models.

D1.justification: V2 adds a project-page link in a first-page footnote. Implementation details and hyperparameters in Appendix B are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish what code or data the linked page provides.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds five Diffusion-DPO follow-up references covering ranked preference optimization, direct consistency optimization, human-utility optimization, step-aware optimization, and self-play fine-tuning. This modestly expands research positioning alongside the narrower introductory research gap.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized prose and notation corrections, specifies Appendix A in a cross-reference, adds acknowledgements, and adjusts affiliation numbering and author footnote markers. The main narrative and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 makes a small Figure 2 caption cleanup and local layout changes through the added footnote, acknowledgements, reference reflow, and removal of printed page-number footers. All figures, image panels, plots, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves accuracy and positioning by correcting the Section 3 DPO formula to agree with Appendix A, acknowledging five additional related works, and narrowing the introductory research gap. The project-page pointer adds access information. These are limited improvements; the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
